description: This PHP source file defines the EditorHooks class implementing various Drupal hooks related to the editor module, including help text, menu alterations, form modifications, entity and file handling, and text format synchronization.

classes.name: Drupal\editor\Hook\EditorHooks
classes.description: Defines hook implementations for the editor module, handling help, menu, element, form, entity, and file hooks, as well as text format synchronization and file usage management.

methods.name: help
methods.description: Provides help information about the Text Editor module, including installation, configuration, and usage instructions.

methods.name: menuLinksDiscoveredAlter
methods.description: Rewrites menu links related to text formats and editors for better clarity.

methods.name: elementInfoAlter
methods.description: Extends text_format element info to notify client-side editors when to enable or disable.

methods.name: formFilterAdminOverviewAlter
methods.description: Modifies the admin overview form to add a column for selecting text editors per format.

methods.name: formFilterFormatFormAlter
methods.description: Associates a text editor with a text format in the filter format edit form, including AJAX handling.

methods.name: entityInsert
methods.description: Handles entity insert events to record file usage for referenced files.

methods.name: entityUpdate
methods.description: Handles entity update events to update file usage counts based on changes.

methods.name: entityDelete
methods.description: Handles entity deletion to remove file usage records.

methods.name: entityRevisionDelete
methods.description: Handles revision deletion to update file usage accordingly.

methods.name: fileDownload
methods.description: Controls file download access, ensuring only accessible files are downloadable based on usage and permissions.

methods.name: filterFormatPresave
methods.description: Synchronizes the status of text formats and their associated editors before saving.

methods.name: recordFileUsage
methods.description: Marks files as used by an entity, making temporary files permanent.

methods.name: deleteFileUsage
methods.description: Removes file usage records for referenced files.

methods.name: getFileUuidsByField
methods.description: Extracts UUIDs of files referenced in formatted text fields of an entity.

methods.name: getFormattedTextFields
methods.description: Identifies fields on an entity that support formatted text.

methods.name: parseFileUuids
methods.description: Parses HTML content to find data-entity-uuid attributes indicating file references.
